Different values of n imply qualitatively different behavior: @ 7 = 0.1: slow contraction Xe+1 = 0.8x¢ @ 7 = 0.4: strong but stable contraction Xe+1 = 0.2x¢ @ 1 = 0.9: alternating but still stable Xey+1 = —0.8x; @ 7 > 1: unstable So memetic design is not just about choosing a local search method, but about choosing its intensity. ’
